arxiv-2102-02963.title: Commonsense Knowledge Aware Concept Selection For Diverse and Informative Visual Storytelling
arxiv-2102-02963.creator: Hong Chen, Yifei Huang, Hiroya Takamura, Hideki Nakayama
arxiv-2102-02963.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Hong Chen, Yifei Huang, Hiroya Takamura, Hideki Nakayama. Visual storytelling is a task of generating relevant and interesting stories for given image sequences. In this work we aim at increasing the diversity of the generated stories while preserving the informative content from the images. We propose to foster the diversity and informativeness of a generated story by using a concept selection module that suggests a set of concept candidates.

arxiv-2105-11991.title: Privacy-Preserving Continuous Event Data Publishing
arxiv-2105-11991.creator: Majid Rafiei, Wil M.P. van der Aalst
arxiv-2105-11991.description: Abstract Process mining enables organizations to discover and analyze their actual processes using event data. Event data can be extracted from any information system supporting operational processes, e.g., SAP. Whereas the data inside such systems is protected using access control mechanisms, the extracted event data contain sensitive information that needs to be protected.

arxiv-2209-04701.title: Subdiffusive semantic evolution in Indo-European languages
arxiv-2209-04701.creator: Bogdán Asztalos, Gergely Palla, Dániel Czégel
arxiv-2209-04701.description: Abstract How do words change their meaning? Although semantic evolution is driven by a variety of distinct factors, including linguistic, societal, and technological ones, we find that there is one law that holds universally across five major Indo-European languages: that semantic evolution is strongly subdiffusive.

arxiv-2211-12820.title: Fairly Allocating Utility in Constrained Multiwinner Elections
arxiv-2211-12820.creator: Kunal Relia
arxiv-2211-12820.description: Abstract Fairness in multiwinner elections is studied in varying contexts. For instance, diversity of candidates, representation of voters, or both are separately termed as being fair. A common denominator to ensure fairness across all such contexts is the use of constraints.

arxiv-2303-15397.title: Quantum Effects of the Conformal Anomaly in a 2D Model of Gravitational Collapse
arxiv-2303-15397.creator: Emil Mottola, Mani Chandra, Gian Mario Manca, Evgeny Sorkin
arxiv-2303-15397.description: Abstract The macroscopic effects of the quantum conformal anomaly are evaluated in a simplified two-dimensional model of gravitational collapse. The effective action and stress tensor of the anomaly can be expressed in a local quadratic form by the introduction of a scalar conformalon field φ \varphi , which satisfies a linear wave equation.

arxiv-2305-13843.title: Advances and Challenges of Multi-task Learning Method in Recommender System: A Survey
arxiv-2305-13843.creator: Mingzhu Zhang, Ruiping Yin, Zhen Yang, Yipeng Wang, Kan Li
arxiv-2305-13843.description: Abstract . Multi-task learning has been widely applied in computational vision, natural language processing and other fields, which has achieved well performance. In recent years, a lot of work about multi-task learning recommender system has been yielded, but there is no previous literature to summarize these works.

arxiv-2404-17834.title: Efficient Reactive Synthesis
arxiv-2404-17834.creator: Xin Ye 1 and Harald Ruess 2
arxiv-2404-17834.description: Abstract Our main result is a polynomial time algorithm for deciding realizability for the GXU sublogic of linear temporal logic. This logic is particularly suitable for the specification of embedded control systems, and it is more expressive than GR(1). Reactive control programs for GXU specifications are represented as Mealy machines, which are extended by the monitoring of input events.

arxiv-2410-06556.title: MPC-guided, Data-driven Fuzzy Controller Synthesis
arxiv-2410-06556.creator: Juan Augusto Paredes Salazar, Ankit Goel
arxiv-2410-06556.description: Abstract Model predictive control (MPC) is a powerful control technique for online optimization using system model-based predictions over a finite time horizon. However, the computational cost MPC requires can be prohibitive in resource-constrained computer systems. This paper presents a fuzzy controller synthesis framework guided by MPC.

arxiv-2509-04733.title: CoVeR : Conformal Calibration for Versatile and Reliable Autoregressive Next-Token Prediction
arxiv-2509-04733.creator: Yuzhu Chen, Yingjie Wang, Shunyu Liu, Yongcheng Jing, Dacheng Tao
arxiv-2509-04733.description: Abstract Autoregressive pre-trained models combined with decoding methods have achieved impressive performance on complex reasoning tasks. While mainstream decoding strategies such as beam search can generate plausible candidate sets, they often lack provable coverage guarantees, and struggle to effectively balance search efficiency with the need for versatile trajectories, particularly those involving long-tail sequences that are essential in certain real-world applications.

Here we wanted to investigate whether duration judgments of digit visual stimuli are biased dep

pmc-10699306.title: Targeted Hyperbranched Nanoparticles for Delivery of Doxorubicin in Breast Cancer Brain Metastasis
pmc-10699306.creator: Malcolm Lim, Nicholas L Fletcher, Jodi M Saunus, Amy E McCart Reed, Haarika Chittoory, Peter T Simpson, Kristofer J Thurecht, Sunil R Lakhani
pmc-10699306.description: Breast cancer brain metastases (BM) are associated with a dismal prognosis and very limited treatment options. Standard chemotherapy is challenging in BM patients because the high dosage required for an effective outcome causes unacceptable systemic toxicities, a consequence of poor brain penetration, and a short physiological half-life.

pmc-10747889.title: A New Successive Time Balancing Time-to-Digital Conversion Method
pmc-10747889.creator: Konrad Jurasz, Dariusz Kościelnik, Jakub Szyduczyński, Witold Machowski, Cristoforo Marzocca
pmc-10747889.description: This paper presents a new self-clocked time-to-digital conversion method based on a binary successive approximation (SA) algorithm. Its novelty consists in combining fully clockless operation with direct conversion of the measured time interval. The lack of any reference clock makes the presented method potentially predisposed to low-power solutions.

pmc-12473966.title: Overexpression of the OsHY5L2 Alters the Fine Structure and Physicochemical Properties of Endosperm Starch in Rice (Oryza sativa L.)
pmc-12473966.creator: Yuan Wu, Mingyang Zeng, Junhao Zhang, Haiyan Jiang, Lixia Ma, Dong Liu, Yongjun Zeng
pmc-12473966.description: Although the role of OsHY5L2 in promoting photomorphogenic development is well characterized, its function in regulating rice quality is poorly understood. In this study, we found that OsHY5L2 plays an important role in regulating starch metabolism and modulating its fine structure and physicochemical properties.

pmc-12526295.title: Molecular Networking in Cosmetic Analysis: A Review of Non-Targeted Profiling for Safety Hazards and Bioactive Compounds
pmc-12526295.creator: Li Li, Shuo Li, Ji-Shuang Wang, Di Wu, Guang-Qian Xu, Hai-Yan Wang, Angelo Antonio D’Archivio, Alessandra Biancolillo
pmc-12526295.description: Molecular networking (MN) is a novel mass spectrometry data analysis method that has advanced significantly in recent years and has rapidly emerged as a popular technique. By visualizing the connections between structurally similar compounds in mass spectra, MN greatly enhances the efficiency with which harmful substances and bioactive ingredients in cosmetics are screened.

pmc-12535314.title: Study protocol for exploring diabetes numeracy and health literacy across Europe (EDUCATE): A multicentre cross‐sectional study
pmc-12535314.creator: Elisabeth J. den Brok, Cecilie Hornborg‐Svensson, Nefeli M. Dimitropoulou, Sofie Broeng‐Mikkelgaard, Mikkel T. Olsen, Lubnaa Abdur Rahman, Ioannis Papathanail, Antje Wiede, Juliane Peters, Peter R. Mertens, Eva Zikou, Georgios Karamanakos, Stavros Athanasopoulos, Asimina Mitrakou, Konstantinos Makri
pmc-12535314.description: AimsEffective diabetes self‐management increasingly depends on the interplay between health literacy, numeracy and digital health literacy, given the growing integration of advanced digital tools into diabetes care routines. Little is known about the current state of these skills among people with insulin‐treated diabetes.

pmc-13035914.title: A multi-step short-term photovoltaic power prediction model based on an improved whale migration algorithm
pmc-13035914.creator: Mengling Zhao, Shan Wu, Yibo Hu
pmc-13035914.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). In view of the significant volatility and randomness of photovoltaic power, traditional forecasting methods are unable to meet the requirements for high prediction accuracy. It is urgent to develop a prediction model with high accuracy and strong stability. Therefore, this study proposes a novel multi-step short-term photovoltaic power prediction model based on Variational Mode Decomposition (VMD), Improved Whale Migration Algorithm (IWMA), and Convolutional Neural Network-Kernel Extreme Learning Machine structure (CNN-KELM).

pmc-13202510.title: Immersive Virtual Reality–Supported Cognitive-Behavioral Therapy for Patients With Mild to Borderline Intellectual Disabilities and Substance Use Disorders: Two Exploratory Studies
pmc-13202510.creator: Samantha Murray, Simon Langener, Hanneke Kip, Randy Klaassen, Saskia Marion Kelders, Dirk Heylen, Joanne VanDerNagel, Tiffany Leung
pmc-13202510.description: BackgroundSubstance use disorders (SUDs) are prevalent and characterized by high relapse rates. Individuals with mild to borderline intellectual disability (MBID) are more likely to develop SUDs and face barriers within treatment related to difficulties they experience with abstract thinking, verbal skills, and generalizing learned strategies to real-world contexts.

pmc-13332064.title: Comparison of scapular muscle activity between painful and asymptomatic shoulders in competitive swimmers
pmc-13332064.creator: Pichaya Hengsomboon, Prasert Sakulsriprasert, Ninwisan Hengsomboon, Sivaporn Limpaninlachat
pmc-13332064.description: This study aimed to compare serratus anterior (SA), upper trapezius (UT), middle trapezius (MT), and lower trapezius (LT) activity between painful versus asymptomatic shoulders within the pain group, and swimmers with versus without pain. This cross-sectional study evaluated 16 competitive swimmers with and without shoulder pain.

pmc-13503992.title: Acoustic Scene-Aware Processing and Auditory Model-Based Compensation Strategies
pmc-13503992.creator: Torsten Dau, Tobias May
pmc-13503992.description: Despite significant advances in our understanding of human hearing and assistive hearing technologies, the benefits of hearing loss compensation continue to vary widely across individuals. A central challenge is the complexity and heterogeneity of hearing loss, whose perceptual consequences often extend far beyond reduced sensitivity.

pmc-13607720.title: Volatile and Cuticular Chemical Profiling and Antennal Dose–Responses in Leptoglossus chilensis (Hemiptera: Coreidae)
pmc-13607720.creator: Ricardo Ceballos, Juan P. Alveal, Carla Alveal, Natalí Fernández
pmc-13607720.description: Simple SummaryLeptoglossus chilensis is a native Chilean insect that damages fruit and nut crops and is a frequent reason fresh fruit shipments from Chile are rejected at import. Farmers currently rely on insecticide sprays because there is no lure or monitoring tool, as the chemical signals this insect uses to communicate were not previously characterised.

pmc-13652487.title: Liver mucinous cystic neoplasm: a challenging diagnosis case report
pmc-13652487.creator: Sana Landolsi, Aymen Saidi, Aziz Atallah, Maroua Yengui, Mohamed Nafaa Arfa, Faouzi Chebbi
pmc-13652487.description: Introduction and importance:Liver mucinous cystic neoplasm is a rare tumor with a challenging pre-operative diagnosis, as for our patient.Presentation of case:A 43-year-old woman complained of dull, aching pain in the left hypochondrial region. Abdominal ultrasound demonstrated a solitary hypoechoic cyst within the left hepatic lobe. The initial suspected diagnosis was a hepatic hydatid cyst due to the country’s endemicity.
